title: Claude on Steam Machine/Deck for testing
author: TheMolluskPod
selftext: Does anyone run their build play tests over SSH with a steam machine or the deck. I think I’m 1/2 way into setting it up. Curious about launching in game mode. I guess add the file as a non steam game? Claude can ship a build right to my hardware to test it there vs the rig itself built on. Anyone set this up or am I super late to the party? Secondly- I think that would make for easy decky plugin maintainer if the vault survives after every update and it can rebuild it the way you had it before…

comments.author: sevenoutdb
comments.body:
Yeah - Claude Code set that up in minutes - build runs great on my OG Steam Deck, make sure you ask Claude to create a performance profiling debug and you are going to need to do a full overhaul of your UI - everything is going to be teeny tiny and you are going to need to be really thoughtful about control binding, and I think you’ll want to create some kind of default game system/hardware profiles because I do have some different camera logic, aim assist, and some more costly scripts and non-game balance enhancements are off by default.

You will need to toggle between desktop mode to install builds (“Add Non-Steam Game…”) and then restart back into Regular Steam deck gaming mode (the UI and performance are different).

Also you’ll want to log into your email on the Steam deck browser because you’ll have to run a few terminal commands on the deck in Arch Linux (SteamDeck’s Linux) to establish the SSH connection. I emailed the long ass terminal command strings to myself which would have been a pain to type on the pretty terrible keyboard. If you have a dock, you might want to have an old wired keyboard handy. 

Once you have SSH set up properly - Claude can launch the app and test things - just as long as the Steam Deck is awake.

replies.author: TheMolluskPod
replies.body: This is awesome!! Thank you. You’re right I’m already done with the connection- but thank you for the ideas on setup. But I am 1 step lazier. I have claude send whatever to my clipboard on the machine then i just click paste
